answer: The evidence cannot support calling this fuel waste or avoidable. Measured: the vehicle was stationary with the engine running for 19m 29s (1169.2 s), from 2021-01-19 09:24:02 to 2021-01-19 09:43:32; 0.626 L of fuel was consumed during this state. Limitation: the available telemetry cannot identify why the vehicle was stationary. Whether the running was needed (for example loading, PTO work, cab heating or waiting in a queue) is not recorded. Investigation: operational context such as location, job state or PTO state would help explain it.
fleetpulse_interpretation: FleetPulse detected an engine-on stationary event: engine speed at or above 300 rpm with wheel speed below 0.5 km/h (rule idle-v1).
FleetPulse classifies this as an extended engine-on stationary event (5 minutes or longer); investigation with operational context is recommended.
It is one of the events over 15 minutes highlighted by FleetPulse.
FleetPulse detected the vehicle state with high confidence. The available telemetry does not identify why the vehicle remained stationary.
limitations: The available telemetry cannot identify why the vehicle was stationary: there is no GPS/location, job, loading or dispatch context.
One vehicle (Turku Renault T520), Part 3 observation window only; this is not a fleet-wide measurement.
Timestamps are logger wall clock with unknown timezone.
Fuel is the FMS fuel-rate indication integrated over time (reconciled with the fuel counter per session); it is not a contractual fuel measurement.
PTO, cab heating and idle-increment switch states are not decoded.
suggested_investigations: Location (GPS) at the time of the event, to see whether the vehicle was at a depot, customer site or in traffic.
Job / dispatch state (loading, unloading, waiting for a slot).
PTO and auxiliary equipment state, and cab heating use (ambient temperature was not reliable in this data).
Driver or operations log for the period.

measured.fuel_method: LFE SPN 183 fuel rate integrated on the 100 ms grid (fresh+valid rows)

rule.definition: engine speed >= 300 rpm AND wheel speed < 0.5 km/h, both fresh and valid, for at least 2 s within one recording session
